tasks.analysis: Variations in the Earth's temperature over time can be explained by changes in the energy absorbed by the Earth from the Sun. The variation in the Earth's seasons occurs because the Earth is closest to and farthest from the Sun at different times of the year. However, seasonal changes do not noticeably change the overall temperature of the Earth over short periods of time. There can be large changes over longer periods of time, though, and these temperature variations over time have affected the Earth's climate considerably. 地球温度随时间的变化可以通过地球从太阳吸收的能量变化来解释。地球季节的更替是因为在一年中的不同时间，地球与太阳的距离有最近和最远之分。然而，季节变化在短时间内并不会显著改变地球的整体温度。不过，在较长的时间跨度内，地球温度可能会发生巨大变化，而这些随时间推移的温度波动已对地球气候产生了相当大的影响。
